text:
Marta (AE): Lee at NorthStar confirmed they need an air-gapped POC. Main asks: secure courier + COA, SBOM (CycloneDX), monthly security deltas, and clear rollback procedure.

Ravi (SE): Quick tech Qs: will they accept USB delivery + tamper-evidence photos? Single curated model to minimize bundle size?

Lee (Customer): Yes to USB + photos. Single model preferred. Also need signed SBOM and reproducible build attestation for auditors.

June (Product Ops): We can create a "poc-slim" bundle (~4-6GB). We strip telemetry and optional tools. SBOM and attestation generated automatically for standard builds (48 hours).

Alex (Security): Airgap requirements: detached signature, SBOM in CycloneDX, signed build-attestation, and courier chain-of-custody. Verification snippet we expect customers to run:

```
sha256sum -c redwood-poc.sha256
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood.pub -signature redwood-poc.sig redwood-poc.sha256
```

Carmen (Legal): Commercially, monthly deltas require SOW with maintenance windows and rollback support. We'll propose a capped retainer for emergency hotfixes; Lee, is that acceptable?

Lee (Customer): Procurement prefers a capped retainer covering up to 3 emergency fixes/year, additional fixes billable up to a cap.

Ravi (SE): Deltas supported for runtime/security fixes only; cannot change model quantization or runtime ABI. Rollback is single-step to previous bundle; customers must keep previous bundle as rollback artifact.

June (Product Ops): For each delta we ship a signed delta-manifest linking base and target bundle hashes and a rollback helper script. If a quantization change is needed, we issue a full bundle.

Alex (Security): Vulnerability timeline: initial advisory within 48 hours for critical issues, mitigation guidance within 5 business days, aim for code patch within 30 days when feasible; exceptions for upstream third-party libs.

courier-bot: scheduled-coa-job queued for poc-slim-1717123456, status=queued

Marta (AE): Action items: 1) Ravi/June: build poc-slim (target 5GB) + SBOM + attestation + delta-manifest template (ETA 3 business days); 2) Alex: draft security questionnaire answers + vuln SLA; 3) Carmen: SOW draft with retainer + emergency cap + escrow clause; 4) Lee: courier COA spec and procurement constraints.

Lee (Customer): Thanks — please include a 60min dry-run checklist and a rollback drill.

Marta (AE): Will do. Tentative dry-run week after artifacts ready. :white_check_mark:
